items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I recorded George at WDSU... I finally got Georgie on my label.

ctx.x: Just got a postcard today from someone in Chicago saying that George is opening a new place there now.
Well, George keeps going. He's always the same. In fact, I think he plays the same horn that he played. That is the instrument himself. He still has the same one he played in the early days.
